# Render-surfaced source mismatches — product lineplan (difficulty utility_line_repairs)
Source: final report of the lineplan render agent (round 1, 2026-10-12), copied verbatim by the coordinator. Items 1–3 are extended-source items routed to rework; item 4 is base-vs-base (BLUEPRINT-KNOWN, base frozen). Also note for the KB audit: the renderer split each extended rule's single combining sentence (listing every factor) across the computation document and the factor documents.

1. Public-way scope versus calculation. The rule covers "a covered exterior water service line, sewer lateral or gas service line service request". But the calculation also handles the septic line: `w_line == 'sewer_lateral' or w_line == 'septic_line'` maps to the sewer line occurrence cap. The rule's scope sentence never mentions septic lines, so a payment the calculation supports falls outside the stated scope. I rendered the cap-by-line table as the calculation has it and the scope sentence verbatim.
2. Unit for living area. The interior wall-restoration and exterior material-upgrade rules use "the large-home area" and "the upsizing area" (`large_home_area: 2000`, `upsizing_area: 2000`), read from the homeowner contract's `square_footage` field. The rule text never states a unit. I wrote "2000 square feet" on the basis of the field name.
3. Recovery share. The workmanship-recovery rules say "the … recovery share of the section repair payments authorized on the request of that completed repair". The calculation (`i_orig_repair` / `e_orig_repair`) adds up section-repair authorizations without subtracting reversals, and the rule doesn't say either way. I rendered the rule's own words, with no netting stated.
4. Two base rules disagree on when a cancellation takes effect. `lineplan_agg_no_overlapping_lines` says "cancels the overlapping plans first, effective the day before the bundle starts", while `lineplan_renewal_and_cancellation` says "the cancellation is effective on the notice date". Both are carried verbatim.
